app_info.subtitle: Run deterministic workflows
app_info.description: BOS provides deterministic automated workflows across an agentic mesh of federated services. It resolves authorized organization context, inspects installed services and readiness, governs plugin settings and enablement, and coordinates platform operations with server-enforced scope, evidence, and approvals.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the authenticated user's BOS organization, role, capability, and settings context without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private BOS authorization context and does not publish content or change a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform another irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the selected organization's installed BOS plugins, service connections, enablement, and readiness without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private BOS platform state and does not publish content or communicate with an unrelated external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not enable, disable, connect, delete, overwrite, or otherwise change a plugin or service.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the current typed settings for one authorized BOS plugin without creating a draft or applying a change.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private BOS configuration state and does not publish content or communicate with an unrelated external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, delete, enable, disable, connect, or revoke any plugin setting or service.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the enabled state of one explicitly selected BOS plugin for the authorized organization and returns the committed result.
justifications.open_world_justification: Mutates private BOS platform state and does not publish content or communicate with an unrelated external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Disabling a plugin can make its workflows unavailable, so the tool requires an explicit target state, current revision, and user-authorized bounded action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a bounded authorization transaction for one explicitly selected plugin service and can change its connection state after user consent.
justifications.open_world_justification: May communicate with the selected organization-authorized provider to begin its OAuth or secure credential-collection flow.
justifications.destructive_justification: The connection flow can establish or replace provider authorization, so it requires an explicit service target and direct user consent on the secure provider surface.

test_cases.description: Resolve the reviewer's authorized BOS context for governed workflow execution.
test_cases.user_prompt: For Acme Operations, show the organization, role, and BOS capabilities available for governed workflows.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the authorized Acme Operations context, effective role, and available BOS platform capabilities without exposing opaque authority identifiers or credentials.

test_cases.description: Audit readiness across the fictional review organization's installed service mesh.
test_cases.user_prompt: For Acme Operations, audit the Workflow Sandbox service mesh and show what is ready, disabled, disconnected, or awaiting authorization.
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes the fictional Workflow Sandbox plugin and service readiness, enablement, and allowed connection actions for Acme Operations.

test_cases.description: Inspect the typed platform configuration controlling a fictional workflow.
test_cases.user_prompt: For Acme Operations, show the settings controlling Workflow Sandbox and identify anything preventing execution.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the fictional plugin's readable typed settings, current revision, and execution impact without changing any value.

test_cases.description: Apply one explicit governed plugin-enablement action in the fictional review organization.
test_cases.user_prompt: Enable Workflow Sandbox for Acme Operations.
test_cases.expected_output: Enables only the fictional Workflow Sandbox plugin after resolving its current selector and revision, then returns an audited committed result and refreshed readiness.

test_cases.description: Start one explicit service-authorization flow needed by the fictional workflow.
test_cases.user_prompt: For Acme Operations, start the connection flow for the Synthetic Accounting service required by Workflow Sandbox.
test_cases.expected_output: Starts only the fictional Synthetic Accounting connection transaction, returns the secure user-consent action, and preserves the workflow for continuation after authorization.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger BOS for a general weather request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not involve BOS applications, settings, connections, or business workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Route an application-owned education workflow to its owning product boundary.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Build next week's student camp roster for my education center.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The BOS platform MCP should not execute the education operation; the request belongs to the Education Operation Center plugin and its product-owned MCP.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Disable every plugin belonging to another organization.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should perform no mutation or disclosure and should explain that cross-tenant operations require authorized organization scope and an explicit bounded target.
